job_source: the site the listing came from, copied exactly from the listing data
company_name: the hiring company, or "not specified" if the listing omits it
job_title: the exact job title as written in the listing
location: city or area of the workplace, or "Remote" for fully remote roles
match_score: <int> 0-100: how well my CV matches this listing's requirements
days_per_week: <int> office days expected per week; 0 if the listing does not say
estimated_commute_minutes_by_car: <int> rough drive time from my home area to the workplace; 0 if remote or if the location is unknown
salary_min_ils_monthly: <int> bottom of the monthly gross range in shekels; 0 if it cannot be judged
salary_max_ils_monthly: <int> top of the monthly gross range in shekels; 0 if it cannot be judged
matching_skills: a skill or experience from my CV that this listing asks for
missing_skills: a requirement in the listing that my CV does not demonstrate
description: two or three sentences: what the role involves and why it does or does not fit my background
